pages.text: The world used to watch you fight titans and say nothing. Rude, frankly. Now it celebrates your wins, drops rocks from the sky, and schedules royalty overhead.$(p)Nothing in this entry needs a button pressed. Live in the world; the world responds.

pages.title: Boss Celebrations
pages.text: Fell any OreSpawn boss within 128 blocks of a village and the village notices: a message in chat, the bell rings itself, and fireworks climb over the rooftops. Hostile mobs stand down for a full 60 seconds of grace — even monsters respect a monster-slayer.$(p)With the creature mods in, guards fire a crossbow volley in salute and every nearby dog does a backflip — see $(l:orespawn_integrations:living_world/creature_kinship)Creature Kinship$().

pages.title: Meteor Nights
pages.text: Rarely — about one chance every couple of nights — a meteor picks a spot 60-100 blocks from someone and commits. Burning warning flares hang overhead for a breath or two, then impact: a crater seeded with up to five blocks of $(thing)uranium and titanium ore$(), and three $(l:orespawn_integrations:bestiary/alien)Aliens$() crawling out of it.$(p)Standing within 64 blocks earns the hidden $(thing)Close Encounter$() advancement. The ore is the apology.

pages.title: Prince Flyovers
pages.text: By day, keep one eye up. On rare occasions the $(thing)Prince$() — a white dragon out of the royal line — glides across the sky some 45 blocks above the ground, crosses the horizon, and is gone. He lands for no one and despawns beyond reach; this is a parade, not an encounter.$(p)Watching from within 96 blocks earns the hidden $(thing)Royal Escort$(). Want one that stays? See the $(l:orespawn_integrations:royal_court/royal_dragon_egg)Royal Dragon Egg$().

pages.title: The Calendar
pages.text: The celebrations keep a calendar. On $(thing)Halloween$(), boss fireworks burn orange and purple. On the nights of $(thing)Dec 31 and Jan 1$(), villages launch volleys over their bells every couple of minutes, boss or no boss — the year earned it.$(p)With Serene Seasons installed the whole system graduates to in-game seasons, seasonal flyover included — see $(l:orespawn_integrations:living_world/seasons)Seasons$().
